name: mdtero-reader
description: Read, parse, and translate papers through your Mdtero account. Connects to the public Mdtero MCP service; this package does not include the parser.

interface.shortDescription: Papers in ChatGPT through your Mdtero account — library, reader, parse, and translate.
interface.longDescription: Connects to https://api.mdtero.com/mcp. Sign in with a Mdtero account. Save Elsevier keys only at https://api.mdtero.com/mcp/settings (never in chat). Campus full text still needs the Relay helper on an authorized campus device. Docs: https://mdtero.com/docs/install.html
defaultPrompt: Use Mdtero to find papers on this question, then open one in the reader.
Check my Mdtero Elsevier key and campus Relay setup.
Parse this DOI once with Mdtero, then open the reader.
